name: application-person-hovercard
title: Person Hovercard
description: Rich profile popover shown on hover or focus of a trigger: avatar, name/handle/role, bio, follower counts, a Follow action, and social links.
useWhen: Previewing a user's profile on hover of their avatar, @mention, or name across comments, feeds, and chat.
You need more than a name tooltip — stats, bio, and a quick Follow action without a full page navigation.
Distinct from the generic Hover Card, which previews arbitrary link/page content rather than person-specific fields like follower counts and social links.
avoidWhen: You only need a plain name tooltip with no bio or stats — a simple Tooltip is lighter weight.
The full profile page is one click away and equally fast to reach — a hovercard adds interaction cost without much benefit for rarely-viewed profiles.
responsiveBehavior: The card is a fixed-width panel anchored to its trigger's bottom-left; on touch devices, hover has no equivalent, so trigger this via focus/tap instead and ensure it doesn't block the trigger's own primary action.
accessibility: The panel opens on both hover and focus, so keyboard users tabbing to the trigger can reach it, not just mouse users.
A short close delay after mouseleave prevents the card from vanishing while the pointer moves from the trigger into the panel itself.
Social links carry aria-label since they're icon-only; the visible name/handle text is the primary accessible identifier for the person, not the avatar image alone.
